purpose: Route-local uncertainty-interval / confidence-region / credible-region controls. Intervals and error regions can cap language but cannot promote routes.

uncertainty_interval_rows.interval_or_region_object: Confidence interval, credible interval, posterior region, profile-likelihood interval, confidence belt, upper/lower limit, error bar, contour, or metadata-only interval invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
uncertainty_interval_rows.interval_construction_test: Declare estimator, target parameter, nuisance treatment, ordering rule, construction family, prior basis if Bayesian, boundary/physical-region handling, and whether the interval is exact, asymptotic, simulation-calibrated, or approximate.
uncertainty_interval_rows.interval_interpretation_risk: Intervals can be misread as posterior probability, discovery evidence, model truth, or candidate support; asymptotic intervals can fail at boundaries, small counts, nuisance degeneracies, multimodality, or non-Gaussian tails.
uncertainty_interval_rows.residual_gap: An interval can bound a parameter or route-local statistic while leaving likelihood, prior, coverage, public-record, observed-sector, and candidate-native debts unpaid.
uncertainty_interval_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer route promotion, candidate identity, prediction, exclusion closure, or observed-sector recovery from error bars, contours, confidence intervals, credible intervals, or upper limits alone.

uncertainty_interval_rows.uncertainty_interval_class: metadata/provenance wrapper; not a statistical interval claim
uncertainty_interval_rows.interval_or_region_object: Archive revision ranges, generated-summary counts, table intervals, and metadata formatting used for custody and navigation only.
uncertainty_interval_rows.interval_construction_test: Metadata counts and revision windows are not statistical confidence or credible intervals and cannot carry inference credit.
uncertainty_interval_rows.interval_interpretation_risk: Stable metadata can make uncertainty language look formal without adding any uncertainty quantification for physics.
uncertainty_interval_rows.residual_gap: Metadata intervals support navigation only; they do not quantify physical uncertainty or route evidence.
uncertainty_interval_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer confidence, credibility, exclusion, or candidate support from metadata ranges or generated counts.
